scientific_integrity: The established Gaussian nullspace and absorption-probability results are credited; all new statements have proofs and a separate finite numerical checker. Numerical diagnostics are not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: The conditional law assumes independent centered Gaussian columns with positive deterministic scales. The sharp critical window applies to one exceptional column at scale a/m; no non-Gaussian extension, rate of convergence or total-variation strengthening is claimed. Historical priority is provisional; relevant 1962 and 1994 sources were only partly accessible.
title: Conditional Gaussian-simplex barycentric weights and a sharp vanishing-vertex crossover
